The '''Centrality Navy''' was the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] branch of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality Council]], in a remote and independent [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Overview==
The navy consisted of thousands of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and was under direct control of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality Council]], but was influenced by [[Centrality Intelligence]] and the [[Scrivinir|Central Administrator]]. Ships of the line were primarily [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaughts]] that were outmoded and considered obsolete by modern Imperial standards. The ''[[Wennis]]'', for example, was a decommissioned Imperial cruiser designated for use by [[Rokur Gepta]], the Central Administrator.

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the Centrality Navy was present at the [[Battle of ThonBoka]].
